mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (3-month change) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as monetary easing reduces discount rates and stimulates economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate below 4.0% signals an overheating labor market that triggers monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS have increased by at least 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0% and remaining there for 3 months), S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days are negative due to higher discount rates and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (3-month change) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as stronger manufacturing activity supports corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has increased by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 1.0% signals economic stagnation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where quarterly GDP growth is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong employment growth (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a tightening labor market that often precedes monetary policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS has increased by at least 0.5% and UNRATE has decreased by at least 0.1 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market recoveries (defined by HOUST rising above 1400 thousand units for 3 consecutive months), S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days are positive as housing strength supports consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during housing market recoveries (HOUST > 1400 for 3 months).
